item.title: 🍽 HUB1 - Sprout Lunch Menu:
item.description: 🍽 HUB1 - Sprout Lunch Menu: A selection of fresh seasonal vegetables that you can combine with a protein of your choice to create your own meal salad.

item.title: 🍽 HUB1 - Homebound Lunch Menu:
item.description: 🍽 HUB1 - Homebound Lunch Menu: Porchetta with baked potatoes and fennel salad. Served with salsa verde and salt-marinated mild green chilli. (13+15)

item.title: 🍽 HUB1 - Globetrotter Lunch Menu:
item.description: 🍽 HUB1 - Globetrotter Lunch Menu: Nasi goreng, a Malaysian wok dish, with a Southeast Asian spiced fish skewer. Served with fresh tomato and cucumber salad, fried shallots, yoghurt dressing and chilli sauce on the side. (3+5+6+7+8+15) GREEN DISH: Dish Nasi goreng, a Malaysian wok dish, with a Southeast Asian spiced tofu skewer. Served with fresh tomato and cucumber salad, fried shallots, yoghurt dressing and chilli sauce. (6+7+8+15)

item.title: 🍽 HUB3 - Lunch Menu:
item.description: 🍽 HUB3 - Lunch Menu: Danish roast pork with potatoes, summer cabbage, cucumber salad and gravy. (1+6+13) GREEN DISH: Dish Lentil patty with potatoes, summer cabbage, cucumber salad and yoghurt dressing. (1+2+6+13)

item.title: 🍽 HUB2 - Lunch Menu:
item.description: 🍽 HUB2 - Lunch Menu: Crispy Spanish pork belly with smoked paprika and creamy mash. Served with citrus and fennel salad. (6+13+15) GREEN DISH: Dish Baked aubergine with smoked paprika and creamy mash. Served with citrus and fennel salad. (6+13+15)

item.title: 🍽 HUB1 – Kays - Lunch Menu:
item.description: 🍽 HUB1 – Kays - Lunch Menu: Chicken pad krapow with jasmine rice, topped with a crispy fried egg and spring onions. Served with chilli oil, prik nam pla, fresh lettuce and cucumber. Also available gluten-free. (1+2+7+8+15) GREEN DISH: Dish Tofu pad krapow with minced firm tofu and jasmine rice, topped with a crispy fried egg and spring onions. Served with chilli oil, prik nam pla, fresh lettuce and cucumber. Also available gluten-free. (1+2+7+8+15)
